verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Gateway JIT Funding is a documented real-time decisioning path: at transaction time, Marqeta sends funding requests to your system, which approves or denies them using your own business rules. The pack confirms that core loop but says nothing about the response time budget, timeout behavior or a configurable fallback when your endpoint doesn't answer. Its webhooks are event notifications, not decision callbacks, so they add nothing here. missing for 10: documented response time budget/timeout, developer-controlled timeout fallback (stand-in) behavior, request/response contract details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
